evidence.summary: Supreme Court struck down the IEEPA tariffs 6-3 in Learning Resources v. Trump on 20 Feb 2026, holding the President lacks tariff authority under IEEPA. The condition he attached to the crash triggered.
evidence.rationale: His pre-registered miss criterion was: the ruling goes against the tariffs and no crash follows. The ruling went against them on 2026-02-20. Six months later the S&P 500 is at 7,730 and up about 11.6% year to date, so no 1930s-scale crash followed. Recorded against the criterion written in Nov 2025, before the outcome was known.
